description: Get a free Taifoon key (no payment, nothing signed): returns api_key (tfr_free_…), shown once. Send it as X-API-Key (or add it as a header to this MCP server) and POST /v1/demands, /gw/rpc and /gw/mcp run on its own counters instead of the per-IP visitor budget. This is where a rate-limited (429) call points. POSTs to the live /v1/register.

wallet_address.description: 0x wallet address that will own the key

name: taifoon_register
